Class ProductionTreeNode

java.lang.Object
org.example.ProductionTreeNode
public class ProductionTreeNode extends Object
Represents a node in a production tree, which can either hold an Item or an Operation. Each node can have multiple child nodes, forming a hierarchical structure. The node also tracks quantities and operations associated with the production process.
